name: Sports Academy
description: Train at world-class stadiums and unlock champion mascots!

reward.name: Golden Boot Lion
reward.fact: The FIFA World Cup has been held every four years since 1930. Brazil has won it the most times — five!

reward.name: Turbo Dolphin
reward.fact: Olympic swimming pools are exactly 50 metres long and hold about 2.5 million litres of water.

reward.name: Sprint Cheetah
reward.fact: Usain Bolt's world record 100m time is 9.58 seconds. He reached a top speed of 27.8 miles per hour!

reward.name: Ice Bear
reward.fact: Figure skaters can spin at over 300 revolutions per minute — that's five full spins every second!

reward.name: Rally Hawk
reward.fact: The longest tennis match in history lasted 11 hours and 5 minutes at Wimbledon in 2010.

reward.name: Century Fox
reward.fact: A cricket ball is harder than a baseball and can be bowled at over 100 miles per hour by fast bowlers.

reward.name: Pedal Panther
reward.fact: The Tour de France covers about 3,500 kilometres over 21 stages — that's like cycling from London to Morocco!

reward.name: Vault Tiger
reward.fact: Gymnasts experience forces of up to 14 times their own body weight when landing from a vault.
